items.why: Side by side Sentinel-2 (10 m) vs Landsat 8 (30 m) Oct 2024 on the same coordinates, 1 km scale bars, 1.6 km vs 0.7 km. Dark segment visible in both. texts: The two satellites were not there on the same day
items.why: Rows: OCT 2024 8 and 22 Oct; OCT 2025 8 and 25 Oct; 2026 26 Sep and 18 Oct; red '2 to 3 weeks apart: resolution or timing? we cannot tell'. Dates match Sentinel-2 and Landsat provenance (14, 17, 22 days), C13.
